Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Film input/candidate-set/compilation/build-receipt headers use full bundle, bound surface and origin/unit/support identities, plus versioned compiler/policy inputs; stale or foreign receipt joins refuse.
2. Canonical film renderings bind full TypedSupport identity and tagged payload for inline evidence, ledger evidence and SourceSupport, including exact points, interval unions, stream and full bundle binding.
3. Same descriptions on distinct bundles, mapping offset changes with stable endpoint IDs, same legacy axis with changed timebase, substituted surface structure/receipt and each one-tick carrier change produce independently distinguishable fingerprints.
4. Equivalent support permutation is stable; gaps and explicit points remain observable. Each omitted-field mutation has an isolated named failure and passing control.
5. Text fingerprint preimages and S0 bytes stay exact; text entry-point anchor refusals remain. The film entry point cannot open until its input and canonical rendering both participate in identity.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- Compiler identity rendering only; hsmm/v3 remains text-only; no generic model-wire V1.

Plan sections: §2, §8.
set.title: [film] render complete film compiler identity and support
